Welcome to Genesis Investment Credit Union

With roots stretching back to 1945, Genesis Investment Credit Union (GICU) Online has a proud history of supporting small-to-medium sized businesses, farms and families in your region.

It's great to offer our customers another banking option that is almost free.

Service The CAD Merchant Way

GICU Online has a number of branches and offices located throughout the nation, where you will be welcomed by our team of locals. They work hard to earn and retain our customers' trust and loyalty every day, and have developed many long-standing relationships as a result.

Made for you

The Genesis Investment Credit Union (GICU) team knows banking and finance, and we know your community because we're part of it. We will work with you to understand your needs and help you find the best solution. We have a wide range of financial services solutions available right now for businesses, farms and families.
